definitions.explanation: The area in an airport or station where arriving passengers exit to meet people waiting for them. The opposite of the departure gate.

examples.japanese: {到着口|とうちゃくぐち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}っている→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: I'm waiting at the arrivals gate.

examples.japanese: {到着口|とうちゃくぐち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1⟦{階|かい}→階：01034_kai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The arrivals exit is on the first floor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}え→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{到着口|とうちゃくぐち}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to the airport arrivals gate to pick up my friend.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧ (arrival) and {口|ぐち} (gate/exit/mouth). A practical travel vocabulary word seen on signs in airports and train stations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {到着口|とうちゃくぐち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧: to wait at the arrivals gate
- {到着口|とうちゃくぐち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迎|むか}えに{行|い}く→迎えに行く：25786_mukaeniiku⟧: to go to the arrivals gate to meet someone
- ⟦{国際線|こくさいせん}→国際線：27502_kokusaisen⟧{到着口|とうちゃくぐち}: international arrivals gate
- ⟦{国内線|こくないせん}→国内線：27501_kokunaisen⟧{到着口|とうちゃくぐち}: domestic arrivals gate

RELATED WORDS:
- {出発口|しゅっぱつぐち}: departure gate — the opposite
- ⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧: arrival
- ⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦ロビー→ロビー：26995_robii⟧: arrivals lobby
- ⟦{搭乗口|とうじょうぐち}→搭乗口：09927_toujouguchi⟧: boarding gate — where passengers board the plane

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{改札口|かいさつぐち}→改札口：09552_kaisatsuguchi⟧: ticket gate — at train stations
- ⟦{出口|でぐち}→出口：02508_deguchi⟧: exit — general term for any exit
- {入口|いりぐち}: entrance — general term for any entrance
